description: This file defines an interface 'RouteParser' within the 'FastRoute' namespace for parsing route strings into route data arrays. It declares a method 'parse' that takes a route string and returns an array of route data arrays, with detailed documentation illustrating its expected behavior.

classes.name: RouteParser
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method for parsing route strings into multiple route data arrays.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a route string into multiple route data arrays, returning an array of arrays representing different route variations based on optional parts.
